subject: design/argus-journal-type-recovery
statement: Stamped draft rebases remain exclusively `draft prepare-lock` operations: verify original bindings, refresh existing complete stamps for the new tree/parent, preserve unstamped source commits, refuse partial/stale stamps, keep the generated lock commit unstamped and share the pinned cache in the temporary installed worktree. The normal per-commit drive context and single-parent binding remain unchanged.
